I can understand that we are neither in Italy nor in France but still.

Beautiful dining experience
Mar 2023 • Couples
My partner and I just had dinner (all dishes from their Indian food menu section) at Sunflower Restaurant. We arrived just before 22:00 with one other couple finishing their coffees inside, expecting to be turned down but the family welcomed us to our table and kindly served us. Despite a language barrier (we speak barely any Vietnamese and they speak limited English) they prepared us wonderful, delicious food in a professional and timely manner and kindly asked us to leave them a review which we are both more than happy to provide. We had three courses of freshly prepared food each and two freshly squeezed fruit juice drinks for a total of 515VND (around £18) total. Highly recommend
